fields.role: One-piece main body providing storage enclosure, compliant hinge, closing lid, and latch beam actuation.
Catch insert providing latch retention undercut and elastic snap-tab for assembly retention.

compliance.allowable_travel_status: within elastic strain limit of living hinge material
compliance.required_travel: sufficient angular travel for lid opening and closing
compliance.root_interface: junction between base and lid along hinge axis

compliance.allowable_travel_status: within elastic strain limit of latch beam material
compliance.required_travel: sufficient hook displacement to clear catch undercut

compliance.allowable_travel_status: within elastic strain limit of snap tab material
compliance.required_travel: sufficient snap tab deflection for insertion into base pocket
compliance.root_interface: snap tab root on catch main body

fields.nominal: engaged when lid closed and latch not actuated
permanent after assembly; press-fit retains catch insert
engaged after insertion; snap tab prevents removal

fields.decision: Select material for living hinge, latch beam, and snap tab to satisfy fatigue life without yielding
fields.why_open: Material property analysis unavailable at this stage
